description: Share subscription / capital contribution records. Fill null fields from wire advices, subscription agreements, and the stock ledger. `amount_at_par_value_usd` is only the legal minimum par consideration (shares × par); actual `amount_paid` often includes premium—do not leave null if the wire amount must match books.
narrative_template: Transaction Details: Received on [Date] from [shareholder] for [number of shares] at par value [par value] via [Wire/ACH] from [Originating Bank/Account] to [Receiving Bank/Account].

placeholders.Date: Settlement / value date on bank confirmation (match ledger entry date policy).
placeholders.shareholder: Legal name of payor as subscriber or stockholder of record.
placeholders.number of shares: Whole shares issued or subscribed on this receipt.
placeholders.par value: Per-share par from certificate of incorporation.
placeholders.Originating Bank/Account: Sending institution and account identifier (e.g. name + last four).
placeholders.Receiving Bank/Account: Corporate receiving institution and account title as on bank records.

field_definitions.shareholder: Legal name of the payor / subscriber.
field_definitions.purchase_date: ISO-8601 date funds received or subscription effective (null = not in generator registry; fill from bank).
field_definitions.shares: Share count for this event (string with commas for readability).
field_definitions.amount_paid: Total consideration in `amount_paid_currency` for this event (null = fill from wire).
field_definitions.amount_at_par_value_usd: Optional: shares × par in USD for minimum par leg only (informational).
